Mod.Name: [Cronos Team] Archeology
Mod.Author: Cronos Team
Mod.Description:
► Unused features found in the game data and code, made usable again ◄
Every option is On by default, except Auto New Game.
◆ Archeology ◆ • Refine GF level: Restore the refine GF level check still in the game code (Dark Matter and Hero-trial need a level 100 GF). • W-Item: Give Tonberry the unused W-Item battle command, allowing two items in one turn. • Auto New Game: Switch on the developers' debug auto start: the title screen starts a New Game by itself after a few seconds without input. • Omega Weapon level 100: Omega Weapon is always level 100, like on PlayStation (1,161,000 HP). • Succession of Sorceress Power: Unlock the never-reachable Information topic "Succession of Sorceress Power" at Edea's house (disc 3). • PlayStation organ: Restore the PlayStation organ of Ultimecia Castle: 8 notes instead of 4, and each note opens its own grate. • Parking Lights: Restore the unused blinking effect of the red lights in Balamb Garden's parking lot. • Train Hatch: The hatch in Timber Owl's base can now be opened. • Disc change screen: Any button closes the "Insert the next disc" picture, and the game always goes on. • Memory card: The save menu says "MEMORY CARD Slot 1" again, as on PlayStation, instead of "GAME FOLDER".
◆ Cronos team ◆ • Hobbitdur: The code master. • Nihil: The one who actually gets things done. • DangerousDom: The mad tester. • Malekith: The mathematician.

LatestVersion.ReleaseNotes: • 1.0 Initial release. • 1.1 W-Item: fix the crash at the end of every battle. • 1.2 New option: Parking Lights. Auto New Game is now Off by default. • 1.3 New options: Train Hatch, Disc change screen, Memory card and Language.
